automations.what_it_does: The agent explains charges line by line from your billing system, takes payments and arrangements and handles plan change requests. Disputes reach an agent with full context.
automations.first_step: Rank billing questions by how often they come up.

automations.title: Announce outages and answer status calls
automations.what_it_does: The agent sends outage alerts with expected restoration times to affected subscribers and answers status calls from live network data. It records trouble reports and confirms when service is back.
automations.first_step: Document how outage information flows from network to customer today.

automations.title: Process plan changes and upgrades
automations.what_it_does: The agent verifies the account, presents eligible offers from your catalogue and completes the change in your billing system. It confirms the new charges and any proration.
automations.first_step: List the plan changes customers request most often.

automations.title: Troubleshoot and book technician visits
automations.what_it_does: The agent runs guided troubleshooting for connection issues and resolves what it can remotely. It books a technician visit with a confirmed window only when one is really needed.
automations.first_step: Write the checks your support team runs before booking a visit.

pains.label: Trip enquiries wait for a reply
Passports and balances chased by hand

automations.title: Answer trip enquiries and book consultations
automations.what_it_does: The agent replies to every trip enquiry in minutes, asks about destination, dates, budget and party size and shares sample itineraries. It books a specialist consultation and keeps undecided travellers warm.
automations.first_step: Measure how long trip enquiries wait for a first reply today.

automations.title: Chase quotes until they close
automations.what_it_does: Every open quote gets steady follow-up. The agent answers questions, handles price objections within your rules, points out limited availability and closes with a payment link or a handover to an agent.
automations.first_step: List open quotes older than a week with the last contact date.

automations.title: Chase passports, balances and documents
automations.what_it_does: The agent chases unpaid balances, passport details, waivers and visa papers ahead of each departure date. It collects uploads, checks they are complete and flags exceptions to your agents.
automations.first_step: Write the document checklist for your most booked trip type.

automations.title: Explain bills and set up payment plans
automations.what_it_does: The agent explains high bills using usage data and sets up payment arrangements within your credit policy. It takes payments and points eligible customers to assistance programmes.
automations.first_step: Collect your payment arrangement rules and the limits on each.

automations.title: Take outage reports and update customers
automations.what_it_does: The agent records the location and any hazards, confirms known outages and expected restoration from your outage system and sends restoration updates. Life-safety calls escalate immediately.
automations.first_step: Map how outage data reaches your call centre today.

automations.title: Process move-in and move-out requests
automations.what_it_does: The agent confirms identity and address, schedules meter reads and service dates and collects deposits where required. It confirms everything in writing.
automations.first_step: List the details you need to start or stop service.

automations.title: Book field appointments and send arrival times
automations.what_it_does: The agent offers available windows for meter installs, inspections and service visits and confirms access needs. It sends the technician's arrival time and handles rescheduling.
automations.first_step: Review how many appointments are rescheduled and why.

automations.title: Book visits and catch missed calls
automations.what_it_does: The agent answers calls missed during appointments and surgery, books wellness visits and notes urgent cases for a triage callback. It takes refill requests and confirms by text.
automations.first_step: Count calls missed during surgery hours in a normal week.

automations.title: Remind owners about vaccines and checks
automations.what_it_does: The agent runs your recall calendar for vaccines, dental work, senior panels and parasite prevention. Owners book directly into the schedule and compliance is tracked per pet.
automations.first_step: Export pets overdue for a vaccine and rank them by how long.

automations.title: Take refill and food-order requests
automations.what_it_does: The agent confirms the pet and medication, queues the request for the vet's approval and tells the owner when it is ready with a payment or pickup link. It answers routine status questions.
automations.first_step: List the medications and foods owners reorder most often.

automations.title: Check in after surgery and discharge
automations.what_it_does: The agent runs scheduled check-ins after surgery, dental work or illness visits, confirms recovery milestones and answers common aftercare questions. Worrying answers go to the care team and outcomes are logged.
automations.first_step: Write the aftercare questions your nurses ask on a follow-up call.

pains.label: Orders retyped from emails and chats

automations.title: Turn emailed and chat orders into sales orders
automations.what_it_does: The agent reads orders from email, PDFs, WhatsApp and calls, then checks items, pricing, credit and stock in your ERP. Confirmed sales orders are written automatically and exceptions go to your team.
automations.first_step: Gather ten recent orders in the different formats customers send.

automations.title: Answer did-you-get-my-order calls
automations.what_it_does: The agent answers confirmation, status and tracking questions from your ERP and sends confirmations and shipment notices before customers ask. Credit-hold cases go to a person.
automations.first_step: Count confirmation calls per week and the answer given most.

automations.title: Reach out when reorders are due
automations.what_it_does: The agent watches each account's buying cycle and contacts the customer when a reorder window opens. It takes standing and repeat orders, applies contract prices and writes the order to your ERP.
automations.first_step: Pick ten accounts with regular cycles and note their usual reorder gap.

automations.title: Guide new accounts through onboarding
automations.what_it_does: The agent collects business details and credit applications in conversation and chases references and documents. It checks the file is complete before handing the account to sales.
automations.first_step: List the documents every new account must provide.
